data.name: Mercure Porto Centro Aliados
data.hotelDescription:
Luxurious Accommodation
Mercure Porto Centro Aliados offers air-conditioned rooms with modern amenities and stunning city views. Each room is equipped with a flat-screen TV, private bathroom, and safety deposit box for your convenience.

Relaxation and Wellness
Enjoy a refreshing dip in the seasonal outdoor pool or work up a sweat in the fitness centre. Unwind in the garden, shared lounge, or on the terrace, and indulge in room service for a truly relaxing stay.

Culinary Delights
Savor Mediterranean, Portuguese, and European cuisine at the on-site restaurant, with options for vegetarian and vegan guests. Let our concierge service assist you in organizing tours to explore the vibrant city of Porto.

Book now at Mercure Porto Centro Aliados for an unforgettable experience in the heart of Porto!

poi.name: Port wine cellars (Vila Nova de Gaia)

cons: Isolated service lapse (English Breakfast tea availability)
Limited taxi pickup/drop-off times near hotel
Minor maintenance issues; some rooms lack drawers
One or two mentions of slightly disappointing breakfast

categories.name: Cleanliness
categories.description: Repeatedly described as extremely clean and tidy in rooms and public areas; minor maintenance requests mentioned but cleanliness praised overall.

categories.name: Service
categories.description: Staff consistently described as very friendly, helpful and attentive; one isolated service lapse (tea availability) noted but outweighed by numerous positive comments.

categories.name: Location
categories.description: Consistently praised as central and convenient—close to train station and main attractions; many reviewers highlight excellent location.

categories.name: Room Quality
categories.description: Rooms described as well furnished, comfortable with pleasant views; a few comments about missing drawers and desired carpet/maintenance issues.

categories.name: Amenities
categories.description: Garden, terrace and outside bar are positives; however the swimming pool is repeatedly criticized as very small and largely decorative.

categories.name: Value for Money
categories.description: Multiple reviewers call it great value, noting high standards and service for the price.

categories.name: Food and Beverage
categories.description: Breakfast is widely described as varied, ample and of good quality; isolated negative feedback (one slightly disappointing breakfast and a tea service mix-up) exists.

categories.name: Overall Experience
categories.description: Overall very positive atmosphere, attractive design and pleasant stay reported by many; some operational negatives (small pool, minor maintenance, taxi pickup constraints) reduce the overall experience slightly.
